meta.name: CCNL per i lavoratori dell'industria alimentare (Federalimentare)

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: split, as the CCNL of 1 March 2024 (FLAI-CGIL text). Minimo tabellare (T.E.M.) by level and tranche, Art. 51 lett. A (1/12/2023, 1/9/2024, 1/1/2025, 1/1/2026, 1/1/2027); ex contingenza frozen at 1 November 1991 and EDR EUR 10.33 for 13 months (Art. 52); I.A.R. of Art. 51 lett. D, which bears only on the tredicesima, the quattordicesima and the TFR, as separate allowances.

IAR tranche September 2027: EUR 11 on parameter 137, reparametrised; the per-level amounts are the column 'Nuovo I.A.R. dal 1/09/2027' printed in Art. 51 lett. D (from 73.73 at level 6 to 169.57 at level 1S).

SENIORITY: five biennial increments (Art. 53); the per-level amounts of the table 'Importi singolo scatto dal 1/8/1998' are consolidated and not recalculated, in force for the whole ruleset. Apprentices accrue none; on confirmation half the apprenticeship counts (Art. 21).

CONTINGENCY ALLOWANCE: the amounts frozen at 1 November 1991 of Art. 52: 1S=545.72, 1=538.70, 2=530.51, 3A=525.83, 3=522.32, 4=519.99, 5=517.65, 6=515.31. The oleario-margariniero categories 1-10 and the viaggiatori o piazzisti tables are outside the 8 modelled levels.
FUNCTION ALLOWANCE 1S: EUR 100 a month for the Quadri (Art. 23, L. 190/1985), modelled as an allowance with role 'quadro' (Employment.roles=quadro) (review of 2026-10-30).

APPRENTICESHIP under_classification (Art. 21 A, CCNL 1 March 2024): two levels below in the first period, one below in the second, the destination in the third, with the periods of the Durata table: levels 3, 3A, 2 at 10/12/14 months, level 4 at 6/14/16, level 1 at 10/10/16; level 5 at 24 months, at the destination from the second period (month 6), the first period at level 6 being the reading of 'two levels below' kept. Level 6 and 1S are not destinations. First-level and alta formazione apprenticeships are not modelled.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 14, the tredicesima paid at Christmas and the quattordicesima (Art. 54).

OVERTIME (Art. 31): the engine holds the first table (Carni, Dolciari, Alimenti zootecnici, Lattiero-caseari: 45% day, 50% night, 60% holiday). The other sub-sector tables (vini-liquori, bevande, acque minerali, distillatori, birra, conserve vegetali, alimentari varie, risiera, molitoria e pastificazione, conserve ittiche, avicoli, involucri) set other night and holiday rates, and most of them a higher column for intermedi and impiegati (up to 70% night, 90% holiday). The base of Art. 31 excludes the IAR and the EDR: the caller states OvertimeEvent.hourly_rate.

limitation.remediation: Model the Art. 31 table of each sub-sector with its operai and impiegati columns.

notes.text: SICKNESS (Art. 47): the 100% and 50% bands of the net normal pay and the comporto of 186 days in 17 months (up to 5 years) and 365 days in 24 months (over 5) are counted over the sickness of every episode in the window. Not modelled: the 90 more days of comporto for disabled workers (L. 68/99); the fixed-term limit (4 months, integration no longer than the INPS indemnity); the apprentice's normal pay for at most six months a year (Art. 21). The net pay is computed by grossing up the INPS indemnity by the worker's INPS rate, as for the Commercio file.

limitation.remediation: Model the 90 more days of comporto of a disabled worker, the fixed-term limit and the apprentice treatment of Art. 47 and Art. 21.

notes.text: Art. 51 bis: the trattamento economico per mancata contrattazione di secondo livello, EUR 21.90 at level 6 to 50.37 at 1S a month for 12 months from 1 January 2023, 32.85 to 75.55 from 1 January 2027, outside the TFR, owed by firms without a premio per obiettivi.

limitation.remediation: Add an employer fact for the premio per obiettivi and pay Art. 51 bis.

notes.text: Art. 31: the premiums on ordinary night, shift night, holiday and Sunday work.

limitation.remediation: Model the Art. 31 premiums on ordinary hours.

notes.text: Art. 73: the EDR enters the TFR base only from 1 March 2024; the file counts it for every period.

limitation.remediation: Date the TFR relevance of the EDR from 1 March 2024.

notes.text: Art. 21 B-C: the pay of the first-level and alta formazione apprentices.

limitation.remediation: Model the first-level and alta formazione apprenticeship tracks.

notes.text: HEALTH AND BILATERAL FUNDS: the employer contributions to FASA (EUR 16 a month), the Cassa maternità, the bilateralità and the Cassa rischio vita (Art. 74 ter-quinquies) are owed for every worker; a firm outside the bilateral funds owes instead the EDR of EUR 20 x 12 of Art. 74 bis. Neither is modelled: the employer cost, and with the EDR the net pay, are short of them.

limitation.remediation: Model the contributions per worker, with a fact for an employer that pays the worker the alternative element instead, then remove this note.

location.section: Art. 47 - 1) Conservazione del posto; 2) Trattamento economico (table p. 110)
location.quote: a) anzianità fino a 5 anni compiuti: 186 giorni di calendario; b) anzianità oltre i 5 anni: 365 giorni di calendario. Cesserà per l’azienda l’obbligo della conservazione del posto e del trattamento economico qualora il lavoratore abbia raggiunto in complesso, durante i 17 mesi antecedenti, i limiti massimi previsti dalla lett. a) e, durante i 24 mesi antecedenti, quelli previsti dalla lettera b), anche in caso di diverse malattie. [...] integrerà l’indennità corrisposta dallo stesso in modo da raggiungere il 100 o il 50 per cento della retribuzione normale netta.

provenance.transformation: Art. 47 1)-2): the company integrates the INPS indemnity up to 100% of the net normal pay for the first 186 calendar days and, over 5 years of seniority, up to 50% for the next 179; the comporto is 186 days within the 17 months before the day (up to 5 years) and 365 days within the 24 months before (over 5), 'anche in caso di diverse malattie', and the same window bounds the treatment ('Cesserà per l'azienda l'obbligo della conservazione del posto e del trattamento economico'). Stored as a cumulation counted over the window, with a band of each seniority. Read on 2026-10-30.

location.section: Art. 72 - Preavviso di licenziamento e di dimissioni
location.quote: Per gli impiegati che hanno superato il periodo di prova, i termini di preavviso per il caso di licenziamento sono stabiliti come segue [...] Giorni di calendario 1° Super e 1° 90 120 150 2° 40 60 90 3° e 3°A 30 45 60 Altri 20 40 50 Per il caso di dimissioni, i termini anzidetti sono ridotti alla metà. I termini di disdetta decorrono dalla metà o dalla fine di ciascun mese. [...] Il licenziamento dell'operaio non in prova o le sue dimissioni potranno aver luogo in qualunque giorno della settimana, con un preavviso di: - giorni 12 di calendario, per gli operai con anzianità ininterrotta fino a 4 anni compiuti; - giorni 20 di calendario, per gli operai con anzianità ininterrotta oltre i 4 anni compiuti.

provenance.transformation: Calendar days. Impiegati (and the quadri of 1° Super) on dismissal by level and service, below 3 years, 3 to 7, over 7: the exact anniversary is read in the lower band (up_to_months 36 and 84), from the middle or the end of the month; their resignation (halved, down to 22.5 days) is not modelled, as the engine computes only the indemnity the employer owes. Operai of any level, 12 days up to 4 years and 20 beyond, from any day, dismissal and resignation alike. The intermedi (2° 30/55/70, 3°A 15/30/45 days) are not modelled: the engine has no intermedio category. The indemnity is the retribuzione of the period (no extra months); the TFR treatment is not stated. The tables for birra e malto and macellazione avicola (pp. 150-151) are not modelled.

findings: 87 records verified; every aggregator and union press source replaced by the signed text. Pages are physical PDF pages, one above the printed page number.

Art. 51 bis, Art. 74 bis, Art. 51 ter and the other contributions declared in one limitation. No renewal or verifica after the CCNL of 1 March 2024 through October 2026.
sickness_half_pay_and_comporto (the comporto of every worker and the half-pay days above five years) is recorded on every run with a sickness event.

reviews.scope: Periodic review due 2026-12-01: the minimi of every level and tranche, the ex contingenza, the EDR, the IAR, the scatti, the indennità di funzione and the extra months against the CCNL of 1 March 2024, and a year and a termination of a 3rd level impiegato against a hand oracle.
findings: Art. 51 lett. A (PDF p. 116): the 40 minimi of the eight levels from December 2023 to January 2027 match the file.
Art. 52 (PDF p. 121): ex contingenza of the eight levels (1S 545,72 to 6 515,31) and EDR of 10,33 on 13 mensilità. Match.

Art. 51 lett. D (PDF p. 118): IAR of the eight levels from December 2023 and September 2027. Match. Art. 53: five biennial scatti, 1S 51,42 to 6 22,35. Match. Art. 23: indennità di funzione of the quadri, 100 euro. Match.

Art. 54 (PDF p. 123): tredicesima and quattordicesima of the monthly pay, in twelfths for a hire within the year; the EDR is paid on 13 mensilità, so the quattordicesima leaves it out, as the engine does. Art. 54 states neither the accrual period nor the payment month of the quattordicesima of the impiegati: the engine and the oracle read them from the gratifica speciale of the operai (PDF p. 215: paid with the June pay, accrued from 1 July to 30 June), an interpretation, not a statement of Art. 54.

Hand oracle (tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/period/sector, scenarios alimentari-year and alimentari-june): a 3rd level impiegato hired on 1 January 2026 by an employer with 50 employees; every payment and the year (gross, contributions, tax, net, TFR, employer cost) match the engine to the cent.
